messages.author: 7e7cccf3cb79cba5
messages.subject: SortableR works locally but not on shinyapps.io or shiny server
parts:
Hello Shiny experts and friends,

Anyone has successfully used the sortableR package on shinyapps.io or shiny server and got it working?

See https://github.com/timelyportfolio/sortableR

Here is a minimal example that works locally but not on a server.

# SortableR Example

library(devtools)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shiny)
library(sortableR)

ui = dashboardPage(
  
  dashboardHeader(title = "SortableR Example"),
  
  dashboardSidebar(),
  
  dashboardBody(
    fluidPage(
      fluidRow(id = "sortme",
               box(title = "Box 1", background = "teal", height = 300,
                   h2("Drag and move me")),
               box(title = "Box 2", background = "light-blue", height = 300,
                   h2("Drag and move me too"))
      ),sortableR("sortme")
    )
  )
)

server = function(input,output){}

shinyApp(ui=ui,server=server)

If you run this locally, the sorting of the two boxes work,

runGist("5d8065beabfbdf29f6c1")
https://gist.github.com/eggbenny/5d8065beabfbdf29f6c1

But when I deployed it on shinyapps.io or shiny server, the sorting stops working.

https://orange.shinyapps.io/sortableR

Any suggestions and tips on how to make it work on shinyapps.io or shiny server are most appreciated.

Best,

Ben

messages.subject: Re: SortableR works locally but not on shinyapps.io or shiny server
parts:
Hello Andy,

Thanks for your tips and help! It works after I included the Sortable.js javascript library on the html head.

Since I'm new to javascript, it didn't occur to me that I need to call the library when deploy on the server. I'm still seeing the same error on my console log probably because it is looking for a local copy, but it is working now after I call the js library from a CDN.

For anyone interested in the solution, this is one way to call the Sortable.js library you need on your ui script:

tags$head(tags$script(src="//cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Sortable/1.2.1/Sortable.min.js"))

Here is the updated code in its entirety, or you can check it out on the gist page. I'm going to archive my example app on shinyapps.io in about a week to make room for other apps.
https://gist.github.com/eggbenny/5d8065beabfbdf29f6c1

# SortableR Example

library(devtools)
library(shinydashboard)
library(shiny)
library(sortableR)

ui = dashboardPage(
  
  dashboardHeader(title = "SortableR Example"),
  
  dashboardSidebar(),
  
  dashboardBody(

# Call the Sortable javascript library on CDN
    tags$head(tags$script(src="//cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Sortable/1.2.1/Sortable.min.js")),

fluidPage(
      fluidRow(id = "sortme",
               box(title = "Box 1", background = "teal", height = 300,
                   h2("Drag and move me")),
               box(title = "Box 2", background = "light-blue", height = 300,
                   h2("Drag and move me too"))
      ),sortableR("sortme")
    )
  )
)

server = function(input,output){}

shinyApp(ui=ui,server=server)
